ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel ratio across visible fluke surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe (image-view) presents a primary high-intensity field with dark trailing margins. Right lobe (image-view) presents a primary low-intensity field overlaid with dense, high-intensity horizontal striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 40-degree pixel angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe (image-view) trailing edge exhibits consistent micro-serration (2-4 pixel amplitude). Right lobe (image-view) trailing edge exhibits irregular, higher-amplitude jaggedness particularly near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe (image-view) follows a convex trajectory toward a tapered distal tip. Right lobe (image-view) follows a more rounded, circular convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel nodes (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the cranial edge of the left lobe (image-view).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense collection of high-intensity linear marks oriented horizontally and diagonally across the dark pigmentation of the right lobe (image-view).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization along peripheral edges; irregular trailing edge contour on the right lobe (image-view) suggests minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark, multi-axial 'X' shaped pigmentation feature is visible in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe (image-view).
